scripts.db:reset: npm run db:down && npm run db:up && npm run migrate
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait redis rabbitmq jaeger
scripts.dev:server: cross-env API_PORT=3108 DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_8 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6308 OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=auction-api OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:4308 npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:web: cross-env API_PORT=3108 WEB_PORT=5108 npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.dev:close-worker: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_8 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://auction:auction@127.0.0.1:5608 CLOSE_WORKER_POLL_MS=1000 npm run close-worker --workspace server
scripts.dev:notification-worker: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_8 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://auction:auction@127.0.0.1:5608 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6308 npm run notification-worker --workspace server
scripts.dev:stripe: cross-env STRIPE_PORT=7108 STRIPE_PUBLIC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7108 AUCTION_WEBHOOK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3108/api/webhooks/stripe STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_local_part_8 npm --prefix ../stripe-service run start
scripts.dev: cross-env API_PORT=3108 WEB_PORT=5108 WEB_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:5108 STRIPE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7108 STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_local_part_8 DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_8 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6308 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://auction:auction@127.0.0.1:5608 OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=auction-api OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:4308 concurrently -k -n server,web,close,notify,stripe "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:close-worker" "npm run dev:notification-worker" "npm run dev:stripe"
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run infra:up && npm run migrate && npm run stripe:install && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgres://auction:auction@localhost:55432/auction_part_8 REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6308 npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
